title: Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: A Witherbloom grad student and dryad who leads a field trip to capture the Devotion, using her students' grief as bait, and tries to teach them about grief.

entities.name: Basil
entities.description: A grieving young elf, a first-year, who lost his partner Mertyn and is still uncommitted to a path; at the end he says he no longer wants to be a mage.

entities.name: Morphia
entities.description: A vampire Witherbloom student and aspiring doctor with an actor's flair, who resists Mertyn's lure and saves herself with a root talisman.

entities.name: Lorenin
entities.description: A soft-spoken Witherbloom student and aspiring mortician who wears scratched hexagonal glasses and carries a scalpel.

entities.name: Mertyn
entities.description: Basil's late partner, a young elf who died in the potions lab; his revenant is the lure used by the Devotion.

entities.name: Mertyn's Revenant
entities.description: The ghostly version of Mertyn that visits the shelter each night and invites students to go with him to the lake alone.

entities.name: The Devotion
entities.description: A grief-hungry water spirit with a mossy skull in its head, which lures grieving students to the lake through the revenant of one they lost.

entities.name: Willowdusk
entities.description: The oldest dryad and a faculty member Dina most wants to be like, who advises her to let students fight for themselves.

entities.name: Killian
entities.description: Dina's close friend, who she compares with Morphia and Lorenin's bond.

entities.name: Witherbloom
entities.description: The Strixhaven college of life, death and decay that all the students and Dina belong to.

entities.name: The Brittleblight
entities.description: A plague of lethargy and despair that took Dina's grove and which she helped cure as an undergraduate.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: A place near the misty forest where the shelter stands and where Basil walks back to.

entities.name: The Shelter
entities.description: An overgrown mobile laboratory shelter near the lake where the group stays.

entities.name: The Lake
entities.description: A miles-wide saltwater lake where the Devotion dwells.

entities.name: The Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The attack in which Dina lost many friends.

events.summary: Dina's Witherbloom students examine a dead giant bird on the path while Basil does not want to watch.
Dina tells her students Mertyn's revenant will appear that night and not to go with him to the lake alone.
events.quote: "Don't go with him to the lake, alone."

events.summary: Mertyn's revenant knocks and Lorenin answers; Mertyn invites him to the lake, and Lorenin refuses and closes the door.
events.quote: "Good night," said Lorenin, and closed the door.

events.summary: The next night Mertyn visits Morphia, embraces her and whispers an invitation, and she throws him off.
events.quote: They held each other tightly, then Mertyn whispered something into her ear

events.summary: By the lake the next morning, Dina tells Basil that grief eats you up no matter what and does not end, it only declines.
events.quote: Grief eats you up no matter what."

events.summary: On the third night Basil goes with Mertyn's revenant to the lake and Dina and the others follow.
events.quote: Then Mertyn held out a hand gloved in thin leather, and Basil took it

events.summary: The Devotion rises from the lake and attacks, and Mertyn's revenant vanishes once he is no longer needed.
events.quote: left behind a vast watery form, a vaguely human shape with a mossy skull buried in its head.

events.summary: Morphia frees herself with a root talisman and, with Lorenin, uses a bit of volcanic rock to calm the water.
events.quote: Morphia flung herself through the water that weighed down her heavy gown

events.summary: The Devotion lifts Morphia and Lorenin out of the water, and Basil's green ray strikes its skull, dissolving the Devotion and freeing them.
events.quote: And then she saw a ray of green light, shooting so fast from Basil's hands

events.summary: Dina makes tea in front of the students with the captured skull in a vessel, and tells them her story about the Brittleblight and asks whether they will build a web together.
events.quote: "You know it destroyed my home—that it was a plague of despair.

events.summary: Morphia and Lorenin agree to stand and grow with Dina.
Basil takes the Devotion's skull to the lake, gently places it back in the water, and says he no longer wants to be a mage before walking away alone.
events.quote: "I just don't want to be a mage anymore," he said

relations.note: Dina is the grad student teaching and trying to guide Basil.
relations.quote: She'd always prided herself on being a supportive teacher and mentor

relations.note: Dina seeks Willowdusk's advice and wants to be like her.
relations.quote: Willowdusk was the faculty member Dina most wanted to be

relations.note: Mertyn was Basil's partner who died.
relations.quote: after the death of his partner, Mertyn

relations.note: The Devotion uses Mertyn's revenant as a lure to draw grieving students to the lake.
The revenant is a ghostly version of Mertyn.
relations.quote: He stood there just as he had on his last morning
